# Elite Healthcare & Community Services (Elite HCS)

> Elite HCS is a registered NDIS provider delivering participant-centred disability and community supports across Victoria, New South Wales, South Australia and the Northern Territory.

Canonical website: https://elitehcs.com.au/
Language: English (Australia)
Phone: +61 415 427 649
Email: enquiry@elitehcs.com.au
ABN: 91 668 512 258

## Services

- Supported Independent Living
- Community Participation
- Personal Activities
- Community Nursing Care
- Travel and Transport
- Specialist Disability Accommodation

## Areas supported

- Melbourne, Victoria
- Sydney, New South Wales
- Adelaide, South Australia
- Alice Springs, Northern Territory
